title: Update Dataproc Cluster
description: Updates the number of worker instances in a Dataproc cluster.

objective.narrative: This sample demonstrates how to resize a Dataproc cluster by changing the number of worker nodes. The `update_cluster` method is used for this purpose, requiring a field mask to specify which part of the cluster configuration is being updated.
